construction_risk_summary.description: Entire floor plate has dense existing MEP at slab soffit (HVAC ducts, fire mains, cable trays). Effective ceiling plenum will be significantly reduced. This may require design adjustment to finished ceiling height or rerouting of services.
Multiple loose cable bundles hanging from slab — bare conductors visible. Must be de-energised, labelled, and secured before any ceiling works.
At least 2 locations where HVAC duct descends dramatically close to floor level — these ducts must be rerouted before partition and ceiling installation.
In several zones, new partition steel stud frames are being erected while demolition debris is still present — risk of structural damage to new frames and worker safety.
Large volume of boards received (P02: 91 LMR boards, P04: 118 boards) — should be reconciled against final BOM to confirm no over-supply or scope creep.
At S13, HVAC duct insulation appears partially damaged — must be repaired/replaced before enclosing within suspended ceiling (moisture/mould risk).
Large demolition debris volume — disposal cost may not be fully captured in BOQ.
